log.summary:
Thirai is RAG applications made for KTU students. Basically, I wanted a LLM that could answer any college/university related questions.

Today, I built its v1 - dumped 14 documents from KTU site (https://ktu.edu.in), indexed it using Qwen2.5:3B and nomic-embed-text models (took 20 mins) and... the output was not that good - I suspect it is due to the formatting/styling of the PDF

Anyway, I used https://gradio.app/ to quickly setup an UI

I built the basics of #BuildInPublic - a web page to publicly track my building activities. Just like yesterday's Scratchpad, this too features a Telegram-to-GitHub integration using Cloudflare Workers.

Additionally, I added streaks and a heatmap to make the whole page more engaging. I expect users who visit to feel somewhat inspired and try building something themselves, for which a CTA has been placed in the footer. :)

Thanks to the folks at https://wsrv.nl/, I was able to handle image compression (my main worry) easily.

These tiny builds are always fun 😌

Today, I built Scratchpad - basically a bookmarking page with short notes, more like a "margined notebook made public."

"Why?" you might ask.

Because I love finding new stuff and have always wanted to see what others have to offer too. See it as a test for something that can be expanded.

Will it get expanded or adopted by others? Most probably not. But I love the idea :D

For this, I had to set up another system: a Telegram ↔ GitHub webhook. All of its code is public at:
https://github.com/FahadLive/Personal-Website
(See `charlie-worker`.)

PS: Telegram and Cloudflare are so cool. There's always something new to discover with them.
til: New functionalities of the GitHub API

log.summary:
Aashaan (Kanakk aashaan) is a web app built to simplify biriyani challenge hosted by NSS Unit 185 - GEC Palakkad

It focuses on simplifying biriyani ordering (Marking count and location), and later delivery too.

The UX isnt fully flushed out, but it is showing potential

Started adding attendance tracking - in the meantime, i fumbled and is having to change already existing events to listing (rename). Which broke every system in place and im currently with -ve progress today
I made the app more responsive - made it faster and improved its UX. I also revamped its UI - Not perfect but its a good start. Notifications, and real time updates are still a work in progress

Yesterday, the output from LLM wasn't great most of them was like - I don't know what you are talking. I suspected the issue was with how tables/diagrams from the PDF was extracted/interpreted. So, I moved to use "pymupdf4llm" - https://pymupdf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pymupdf4llm/index.html

And it worked fairly well! And the indexing/embedding time was cut down from 20 mins to 2 mins!! (Thats a win-win if you ask me)

Next up - I need add more data, polish the UI and publish it

Moved to cloudflare - bye bye supabase. Used D1 db, R2 bucket and workers to achieve the full capability. Resurfaced hidden attendance feature too. attendance tracking is still sketchy - will sit on it.

Was feeling a bit creative and decided to make a scrapbook style wallpaper. While creating the wallpaper, I saw a stamp-like potrait and made my own. At last decided to make it the hero potrait, really really happy with the result
I contributed to the project by adding favicon and opengraph - opengraph is AI agenerated but I really like the project and always love to see link previews. So this made me happy 🙂
I revamped admin dashboard UI and integrated some part of it to the actual site data. It needs more work - but I really liked the minimalist (yet stock) look
